reviews.title: The app is horrible
reviews.text:
It really shouldn’t be this hard to plan a trip. The app is filled with ads to upgrade and do you want to be a host, but little info or ability to actually plan ur trip, you should be able to have the app figure out the stop locations based on travel times 5 hr drive per day etc.

Secondly there needs to an option for late arrivals yes/no, and there is a difference between “open from/until” and latest allowed arrival time!

reviews.title: Planning trips
reviews.text: This website is not the most user friendly. Difficult to book stays.

reviews.title: AI only support is a joke
reviews.text: There is no actual way to get a real person on the help chat when things go wrong. There is not a phone number for support. It will charge you for a membership that you have NO way to cancel. This app is a scam!!!

reviews.title: Booking with Hosts
reviews.text: Not an easy task and not many take 40, rig with tow behind. Was not able to use when traveling from South Carolina to North Carolina

reviews.title: High Prices, No amenities
reviews.text: This was a great idea at first, but now has turned into costly option. I understand the first night is free and that extended nights are a bonus. But, at this point a lot of the Hosts are now charging the same rates as RV parks. Some of these Hosts are charging upwards of $50 a night, for a simple parking spot. No electrical, no water and no dumping options. The whole idea was to help a local business, by them letting you stay a day or two and you help the business by purchasing goods. Harvest Hosts is just enabling the Hosts to now charge high prices for a glorified parking spot. It’s unfortunate that this has gotten out of control.

reviews.title: Slam renewal
reviews.text: No warning for 179$ app I have never found a use for.

reviews.title: Not useable
reviews.text:
We have a Ford F150 with a small toy hauler. We are having trouble finding a place that will take a total length of over 25 ft. This needs to be said up front before we purchase a membership. 

This is also not useable for traveling cross country and making reservations as you go. We are having trouble finding places that accept same day reservations, and there is no way to contact a host: no email, phone number, or chatting capability is offered in this app. 

This membership was a waste of our money.

reviews.title: Great program but app needs work
reviews.text: App can get quite buggy.  Sender and recipient names get mixed up in messaging.  Autocorrect doesn't work, and completely resets each time it's minimized.  Hope these can get fixed.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text:
Today has been incredibly frustrating dealing with this company. My credit card would not process on their website, so I contacted customer service. Their chat support does not even respond, and after finally getting an email response, I was told to reset my payment information and switch to Apple Pay.

I followed the instructions exactly and was then told the issue had been fixed, but my account still has not been updated and I still cannot renew my subscription.

For a company handling subscriptions and payments, I expected far better customer service and communication. Based on my experience today, I would not expect solid customer service from this company.

reviews.title: Not very helpful
reviews.text: I got this app because when I searched my area there were quite a few hosts. Spent the $180 to join and what do you know, I’m in a quiet area. Noone within 50 miles. What a waste of money and time.

reviews.title: Error report
reviews.text: Like HH but every request generates an error message

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: Having a hell of a time logging into my account, there’s no human to speak to, they charge too much for this and then when you’re a member, I still want $30 every night you stop and camp, so I think it’s a rip off. I am doing my best to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Error-prone app and unhelpful support
reviews.text:
Multiple times now I have tried to request a stay at a host, only to have the harvest host app (and website) give me the error that my requested date is outside of the hosts booking window, when it very much is not!
Their support, while friendly, have asked their devs to look into this, and finally said that they didn’t know why it wasn’t working. That’s really concerning.

This is a pretty frustrating app and subscription $$$ if it frequently doesn’t work, and their devs don’t know why!

reviews.title: Difficult to cancel
reviews.text: Once subscribed, I found canceling successfully to be very difficult. Little to no communication following my requests, but nearly daily repeated attempts to bill my card on file. The listing of hosts is a nice idea, but I did not find it groundbreaking.

reviews.title: No Offline Access!
reviews.text: Terrible that this app claims to be for boondocking and other remote places like farms yet it doesn’t work at all offline. At a minimum you should be able to access existing trips offline. This would allow access to the host’s address, check in times, etc.  Instead you need to save this information outside of the app - annoying since you don’t know if the area will have good cell service until you get there.

reviews.title: Impossible to cancel
reviews.text: I haven’t used HH in over 7 years.  Every year they bill me.  Every year I have to use their website (not app) and click cancel.   Every year after. I get billed.  Expect this if you subscribe
